sources.title: Top 26 Krea2 LoRA models for Stylized Image Generation
sources.snippet: Krea2 Realism V1 LoRA is designed to improve photorealistic image generation by enhancing skin textures, human anatomy, and clothing details. It produces natural-looking results across diverse ethnicities, ages, and body types, making it suitable for a wide range of portrait and character generation tasks.

sources.title: RawGirl [Krea2] - v3.0 | Krea 2 LoRA | Civitai
sources.snippet: Real-photo energy, zero AI gloss. This LoRA nails that raw, straight-off-an-iPhone look — deep focus, everything sharp, no fake bokeh, no editorial polish. Just candid, unposed, "my friend caught me mid-laugh" vibes. Think messy rooms, natural skin, real lighting, and that grainy front-cam realism that actually looks posted, not rendered.

sources.title: [VRAM 12GB] A Complete Guide to Creating Character LoRAs with the Image ...
sources.snippet: In this experiment, I was able to run LoRA training for Krea2, a super heavy-duty latest model, on a local 12GB VRAM graphics card. I couldn't have made a LoRA for Krea2 without musubi-tuner, so I am truly grateful to kohya-san!

sources.title: Krea 2 Turbo LoRA 256dim - v1.0 | Krea 2 LoRA | Civitai
sources.snippet: Here are the recommended settings I use with the Turbo LoRA on the Raw Krea 2 checkpoint: 0.6 weight, and 12 steps at 1CFG. This allows for a bit more diversity and adherence imo.
